Question B-001-010-007.

Why the correct answer is right: The 430.0 MHz to 450.0 MHz range is the band named in the bank where amateur operation must not interfere with other services.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "7.0 MHz to 7.1 MHz": The 7.0 MHz to 7.1 MHz range is an amateur HF range in the choices, but it is not the shared-band interference example tested here.
- sourceIndex 2: "144.0 MHz to 148.0 MHz": The 144.0 MHz to 148.0 MHz band is not the option the bank uses for this must-not-interfere-to-other-services point.
- sourceIndex 3: "14.0 MHz to 14.2 MHz": The 14.0 MHz to 14.2 MHz range is not the UHF shared-service example identified by the official answer.
